note: Found by searching, anonymously and read-only, by meta-macbook-20261120-4 for tasks/034 (req-hoomd-oldroyd-b-001, req-rheotool-oldroyd-b-001). Read for the CFD agent: Table 4.1 lists the Oldroyd-B model (TypeName Oldroyd-B, and Oldroyd-BLog for the log-conformation approach) with constants etaS, etaP and lambda and the upper-convected equation tau + lambda times its upper-convected derivative = etaP (grad u + grad u^T); section 3.2.2 relates the stress to the conformation tensor; rheoFoam takes fvOptions in its momentum equation (listing of section 4.7.1) and the changelog adds cyclicAMI support; tutorial 5.1.3 (tutorials/rheoFoam/Channel/Oldroyd-BLog) is the flow between parallel plates driven by a uniform inlet velocity, steady, compared with the analytical fully developed profiles of its reference [49] (Na and Yoo 1991). Critique: the tutorial is not a start-up flow, and its inlet-driven channel is not the pressure-driven start-up of Waters and King (mat-20261121-amoreira-oliveira-2010-startup); the start-up case must be set up anew from the solver's options, which this guide documents but does not exemplify for this flow. The guide is version 6.0; whether the image rheotool:of90 carries the same release is to be read off the adapter's trial.
